description: This file contains shell script code for managing custom iptables chains and hooks related to specific network interfaces (LAN and WAN). It includes setup, verification, and cleanup procedures for firewall rules, with references to external commands like iptables and ip, in addition to variable and function definitions specific to this script.

methods.name: Create R alias
methods.description: Defines an alias 'R' for executing remote commands or scripts.

methods.name: Detect LAN and WAN interfaces
methods.description: Detects LAN and WAN network interfaces using ip and awk commands.

methods.name: Create chains and hook
methods.description: Creates custom iptables chains and hooks them into the INPUT chain based on detected interfaces.

methods.name: Verify hooks
methods.description: Verifies whether the iptables rules for LAN and WAN hooks are present.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Removes iptables rules and chains related to LAN and WAN hooks, and resets the state.
